examples.text: Antigamente todas as crianças podiam diferenciar o bom do ruim.
examples.en: In the old days, every child could tell the difference between good and bad.

examples.text: Hoje em dia as pessoas são mais educadas do que antigamente.
examples.en: People are more educated now than they used to be.

examples.text: Antigamente, pensava-se que a Terra era plana.
examples.en: Previously people believed the earth was flat.

examples.text: Antigamente, as pessoas acreditavam que a Terra era plana.
examples.en: Previously people believed the earth was flat.
